en: where do send to fba entries go
hg: fba dispatch kya hai
fba ko bheja maal kahan dikhta hai

a.en: FBA Dispatch lists every Send to FBA the store makes; the FBA team accepts the pieces, ships them to Amazon, or returns them to the store.
a.hi: FBA Dispatch में स्टोर के हर Send to FBA की लिस्ट है; FBA टीम पीस accept करती है, Amazon को ship करती है, या स्टोर को वापस करती है।
a.hg: FBA Dispatch me store ke har Send to FBA ki list hai; FBA team pieces accept karti hai, Amazon ko ship karti hai, ya store ko wapas karti hai.

hg: fba dispatch kaise accept kare
store se aaye pieces kaise accept kare

a.en: When the pieces are in your hands, press Accept on the row, or tick several rows and press Accept ticked.
a.hi: जब पीस आपके हाथ में हों, लाइन पर Accept दबाएँ, या कई लाइनें टिक करके Accept ticked दबाएँ।
a.hg: Jab pieces aapke haath me hon, line par Accept dabaiye, ya kai lines tick karke Accept ticked dabaiye.

en: ship to amazon with shipment id
hg: fba shipped kaise mark kare
shipment id kahan daale

a.en: Press Ship on the row (or tick rows and press Ship ticked), type the Shipment id and Ship date, then press Mark shipped.
a.hi: लाइन पर Ship दबाएँ (या लाइनें टिक करके Ship ticked), Shipment id और Ship date भरें, फिर Mark shipped दबाएँ।
a.hg: Line par Ship dabaiye (ya lines tick karke Ship ticked), Shipment id aur Ship date bhariye, phir Mark shipped dabaiye.

en: only some pieces going to amazon
hi: डिस्पैच से कम पीस ship करने हैं
hg: dispatch se kam pieces ship karne hain
kuch pieces hi amazon ja rahe hain

a.en: Press Ship on that single row, change Pieces shipped, and write the reason in If fewer — why the rest come back; the rest go back into store stock.
a.hi: उसी एक लाइन पर Ship दबाएँ, Pieces shipped बदलें, और If fewer — why the rest come back में कारण लिखें; बाकी पीस स्टोर स्टॉक में वापस जाते हैं।
a.hg: Usi ek line par Ship dabaiye, Pieces shipped badliye, aur If fewer — why the rest come back me reason likhiye; baaki pieces store stock me wapas jate hain.

hi: Excel से FBA ship कैसे करें
hg: excel se fba ship kaise kare
seller central ki shipment file kaise daale

a.en: Press Ship from Excel and choose the shipment file from Seller Central (or one with Shipment ID, SKU, Pieces, Ship date); check the preview and press Ship … dispatch(es).
a.hi: Ship from Excel दबाएँ और Seller Central की शिपमेंट फ़ाइल चुनें (या Shipment ID, SKU, Pieces, Ship date वाली); प्रीव्यू देखें और Ship … dispatch(es) दबाएँ।
a.hg: Ship from Excel dabaiye aur Seller Central ki shipment file chuniye (ya Shipment ID, SKU, Pieces, Ship date wali); preview dekhiye aur Ship … dispatch(es) dabaiye.

en: how to return fba pieces to store
hi: FBA के पीस स्टोर को वापस कैसे करें
hg: fba ke pieces store ko wapas kaise kare
amazon nahi bhej rahe wapas karna hai

a.en: Press Return on the row (or Return ticked), fill Why they are not going, change Pieces coming back if only some, and press Return to the store.
a.hi: लाइन पर Return दबाएँ (या Return ticked), Why they are not going भरें, कुछ ही पीस हों तो Pieces coming back बदलें, और Return to the store दबाएँ।
a.hg: Line par Return dabaiye (ya Return ticked), Why they are not going bhariye, kuch hi pieces hon to Pieces coming back badliye, aur Return to the store dabaiye.

hg: galti se shipped ho gaya
accept wapas kaise le

a.en: Press Undo ship on a shipped row to put it back to accepted, or Undo accept to put it back to waiting; then do the step again correctly.
a.hi: shipped लाइन पर Undo ship दबाएँ तो वह accepted पर लौटती है, या Undo accept से waiting पर; फिर स्टेप सही से दोबारा करें।
a.hg: Shipped line par Undo ship dabaiye to woh accepted par lautti hai, ya Undo accept se waiting par; phir step sahi se dobara kijiye.

en: no accept button on fba dispatch
hi: FBA डिस्पैच में बटन नहीं दिख रहे
hg: fba dispatch me button nahi dikh rahe
tick box nahi hai

a.en: Only people who have the FBA Dispatch tab (or an admin) can accept, ship or return; ask an admin to give you the FBA Dispatch tab.
a.hi: सिर्फ़ जिनके पास FBA Dispatch टैब है (या एडमिन) वही accept, ship या return कर सकते हैं; एडमिन से FBA Dispatch टैब माँगें।
a.hg: Sirf jinke paas FBA Dispatch tab hai (ya admin) wahi accept, ship ya return kar sakte hain; admin se FBA Dispatch tab maangiye.

hg: left alone kyu likha aaya
kuch accept nahi hua

a.en: Somebody else already acted on that row (or it was deleted in the store), so it was left alone; press Refresh to see where it stands now.
a.hi: उस लाइन पर किसी और ने पहले ही काम कर दिया (या स्टोर में डिलीट हो गई), इसलिए उसे छोड़ दिया गया; अभी की हालत देखने के लिए Refresh दबाएँ।
a.hg: Us line par kisi aur ne pehle hi kaam kar diya (ya store me delete ho gayi), isliye use chhod diya gaya; abhi ki haalat dekhne ke liye Refresh dabaiye.

hi: दिन, not shipped लाल क्यों है
hg: days not shipped laal kyu hai
accept hua par ship nahi hua

a.en: The row was accepted 3 or more days ago and is still not marked shipped: press Ship with the shipment id, or use Ship from Excel with the shipment file.
a.hi: लाइन 3 या ज़्यादा दिन पहले accept हुई और अभी तक shipped नहीं: shipment id के साथ Ship दबाएँ, या शिपमेंट फ़ाइल से Ship from Excel करें।
a.hg: Line 3 ya zyada din pehle accept hui aur abhi tak shipped nahi: shipment id ke saath Ship dabaiye, ya shipment file se Ship from Excel kijiye.

en: from the ready goods sheet meaning
hi: From the Ready Goods sheet का मतलब
hg: from the ready goods sheet ka matlab
purane fba dispatch

a.en: Those are old dispatches brought in from the Ready Goods sheet; they went to Amazon long ago and are history, not work, so nothing needs doing on them.
a.hi: ये Ready Goods sheet से आए पुराने डिस्पैच हैं; ये बहुत पहले Amazon जा चुके, सिर्फ़ इतिहास हैं, इन पर कुछ नहीं करना।
a.hg: Yeh Ready Goods sheet se aaye purane dispatch hain; yeh bahut pehle Amazon ja chuke, sirf history hain, in par kuch nahi karna.

hi: एफबीए डिस्पैच के स्टेटस का मतलब
hg: fba dispatch ke status ka matlab
waiting accepted shipped returned

a.hi: स्टोर का स्टॉक Send to FBA सेव होते ही घट जाता है। FBA Dispatch में लाइन फिर waiting → accepted (FBA टीम के पास पीस) → shipped (शिपमेंट आईडी के साथ), या सारे पीस लौटे तो returned। wa…
a.hg: Store ka stock Send to FBA save hote hi ghat jaata hai. FBA Dispatch me line phir waiting → accepted (FBA team ke paas pieces) → shipped (shipment id ke saath), ya saare pieces laute to …

en: ship fewer pieces than dispatched what happens to rest
hi: डिस्पैच से कम शिप किया बाकी का क्या
hg: dispatch se kam ship kiya baaki ka kya
aadha return fba

a.en: On a single row, Ship with fewer Pieces shipped needs If fewer — why the rest come back, and the rest go back into Finished Goods straight away as a back from FBA row. Return of fewe…
a.hi: एक लाइन पर कम Pieces shipped के साथ Ship करने पर If fewer — why the rest come back भरना पड़ता है, और बाकी पीस तुरंत Finished Goods में back from FBA लाइन बनकर लौट आते हैं। खुले से कम Ret…
a.hg: Ek line par kam Pieces shipped ke saath Ship karne par If fewer — why the rest come back bharna padta hai, aur baaki pieces turant Finished Goods me back from FBA line bankar laut aate hain…

en: how does ship from excel match rows
ship from excel did not ship some skus
hi: शिप फ्रॉम एक्सेल लाइनें कैसे मिलाता
hg: ship from excel line kaise milata
excel se kuch sku ship nahi hue

a.en: Each file row is matched to that SKU's open (waiting or accepted) dispatches, oldest first, and ships whole dispatches only. If the next dispatch has more pieces open than the file has left, it is not split — s…
a.hi: फ़ाइल की हर लाइन उस SKU के खुले (waiting या accepted) डिस्पैच से मिलती है, पुराना पहले, और सिर्फ़ पूरे डिस्पैच शिप होते हैं। अगर अगले डिस्पैच में फ़ाइल के बचे से ज़्यादा पीस खुले हैं तो वह बँटता नहीं — उसे उसकी…
a.hg: File ki har line us SKU ke khule (waiting ya accepted) dispatch se milti hai, purana pehle, aur sirf poore dispatch ship hote hain. Agar agle dispatch me file ke bache se zyada pieces khule hain to wo bat-ta na…

en: undo a return in fba dispatch
returned by mistake how to undo
hg: fba return undo kaise kare
galti se return kar diya

a.en: Undo goes one step back: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting. A return is not undone there: it is undone by deleting its back from FBA row in Finished Goods → Every movement (an editor can do i…
a.hi: Undo एक कदम पीछे जाता है: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting। रिटर्न वहाँ अनडू नहीं होता: उसके लिए Finished Goods → Every movement में उसकी back from FBA लाइन डिलीट करें (एडिट वाला कर सकता है)…
a.hg: Undo ek kadam peeche jaata hai: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting. Return wahan undo nahi hota: uske liye Finished Goods → Every movement me uski back from FBA line delete kijiye (edit wala k…

hg: fba dispatch tiles ka matlab
pieces waiting tile

a.en: The tiles count open pieces (sent less returned): Pieces waiting, Accepted, not shipped, Shipped and Returned to the store. A red tile counts dispatches accepted 3 or more days ago and stil…
a.hi: टाइल खुले पीस गिनती हैं (भेजे माइनस लौटे): Pieces waiting, Accepted, not shipped, Shipped और Returned to the store। लाल टाइल उन डिस्पैच को गिनती है जो 3 या ज़्यादा दिन पहले accept हुए और अभ…
a.hg: Tile khule pieces ginti hain (bheje minus laute): Pieces waiting, Accepted, not shipped, Shipped aur Returned to the store. Laal tile un dispatch ko ginti hai jo 3 ya zyada din pehle accept…

en: send to fba already reduced store stock
fba return puts stock back when
hi: Send to FBA से स्टोर स्टॉक पहले ही कम हो गया
hg: send to fba se store stock pehle hi kam ho gaya
fba return se stock kab wapas aata h

a.en: Send to FBA takes the pieces out of the India Store at once; FBA Dispatch then accepts, ships or returns them, and a return (or shipping fewer than sent) puts the rest back into Finished Goods stock straight away.
a.hi: Send to FBA पीस को India Store से तुरंत निकाल देता है; फिर FBA Dispatch उन्हें accept, ship या return करता है, और return (या भेजे से कम ship) करने पर बाकी तुरंत Finished Goods स्टॉक में वापस आ जाते हैं।
a.hg: Send to FBA piece ko India Store se turant nikaal deta hai; phir FBA Dispatch unhe accept, ship ya return karta hai, aur return (ya bheje se kam ship) karne par baaki turant Finished Goods stock me wapas aa jaate hain.

title.hi: FBA को भेजे डिस्पैच accept करना
title.hg: FBA ko bheje dispatch accept karna

steps.en: Let's accept the pieces the store has sent to the FBA team. Only the FBA team can do this.
steps.hi: चलिए स्टोर के भेजे पीस FBA टीम की ओर से accept करते हैं। यह सिर्फ FBA टीम कर सकती है।
steps.hg: Chaliye store ke bheje piece FBA team ki taraf se accept karte hain. Ye sirf FBA team kar sakti hai.

steps.en: Keep To do — waiting or accepted (or Waiting to be accepted).
steps.hi: To do — waiting or accepted (या Waiting to be accepted) रखें।
steps.hg: To do — waiting or accepted (ya Waiting to be accepted) rakhiye.

steps.en: Narrow the list — type a SKU, colour or size.
steps.hi: लिस्ट छोटी करें — SKU, रंग या साइज़ लिखें।
steps.hg: List chhoti kijiye — SKU, rang ya size likhiye.

steps.en: Tick the lines you have received (or press Accept on a single line).
steps.hi: जो लाइनें मिल गईं उन्हें टिक करें (या एक लाइन पर Accept दबाएँ)।
steps.hg: Jo lines mil gayi unhe tick kijiye (ya ek line par Accept dabaiye).

steps.en: Press Accept. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Accept दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Accept dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says how many were accepted, and which were left alone and why.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कितने accept हुए, और कौन से छोड़े गए और क्यों।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kitne accept hue, aur kaun se chhode gaye aur kyun.

title.en: Mark a dispatch shipped to Amazon
title.hi: डिस्पैच को Amazon भेजा हुआ दर्ज करना
title.hg: Dispatch ko Amazon bheja hua darj karna

steps.en: Let's mark pieces shipped with their Amazon shipment id. Only the FBA team can do this.
steps.hi: चलिए पीस को उनके Amazon shipment id के साथ shipped दर्ज करते हैं। यह सिर्फ FBA टीम कर सकती है।
steps.hg: Chaliye piece ko unke Amazon shipment id ke saath shipped darj karte hain. Ye sirf FBA team kar sakti hai.

steps.en: Find the line — type the SKU.
steps.hi: लाइन ढूँढें — SKU लिखें।
steps.hg: Line dhoondhiye — SKU likhiye.

steps.en: Press Ship on the line (or tick several and press Ship ticked).
steps.hi: लाइन पर Ship दबाएँ (या कई टिक करके Ship ticked)।
steps.hg: Line par Ship dabaiye (ya kai tick karke Ship ticked).

steps.en: Type the Shipment id (FBA15…).
steps.hi: Shipment id लिखें (FBA15…)।
steps.hg: Shipment id likhiye (FBA15…).

steps.en: Today's Ship date is filled in — change it if it went another day.
steps.hi: आज की Ship date भरी है — किसी और दिन गया हो तो बदलें।
steps.hg: Aaj ki Ship date bhari hai — kisi aur din gaya ho to badaliye.

steps.en: Pieces shipped is everything open. If fewer are going, change it — the rest go back to the store.
steps.hi: Pieces shipped में सारे खुले पीस हैं। कम जा रहे हों तो बदलें — बाकी स्टोर में वापस जाएँगे।
steps.hg: Pieces shipped me saare khule piece hain. Kam ja rahe hon to badaliye — baaki store me wapas jayenge.

steps.en: Fewer pieces? Say why the rest come back.
steps.hi: कम पीस? लिखें बाकी क्यों वापस आ रहे हैं।
steps.hg: Kam piece? Likhiye baaki kyun wapas aa rahe hain.

steps.en: Check it, then press Mark shipped. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: सब चेक करें, फिर Mark shipped दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Sab check kijiye, phir Mark shipped dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says what shipped under which shipment.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है किस shipment में क्या गया।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kis shipment me kya gaya.

title.en: Ship dispatches from an Excel file
title.hi: Excel फ़ाइल से डिस्पैच ship करना
title.hg: Excel file se dispatch ship karna

steps.en: Let's mark a whole shipment shipped from its file — the Seller Central contents file or our template.
steps.hi: चलिए पूरी shipment उसकी फ़ाइल से shipped करते हैं — Seller Central की फ़ाइल या हमारा template।
steps.hg: Chaliye poori shipment uski file se shipped karte hain — Seller Central ki file ya hamara template.

steps.en: Press Ship from Excel and choose the file.
steps.hi: Ship from Excel दबाएँ और फ़ाइल चुनें।
steps.hg: Ship from Excel dabaiye aur file chuniye.

steps.en: Read the table: each SKU is matched to its open dispatches, oldest first. Lines in red under Left over must be shipped on their own row.
steps.hi: टेबल पढ़ें: हर SKU उसके खुले डिस्पैच से मिलाया गया है, पुराने पहले। Left over में लाल लाइनें अपनी लाइन पर अलग से ship करें।
steps.hg: Table padhiye: har SKU uske khule dispatch se milaya gaya hai, purane pehle. Left over me laal lines apni line par alag se ship kijiye.

steps.en: Check it, then press Ship. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: सब चेक करें, फिर Ship दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Sab check kijiye, phir Ship dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says how many dispatches and pieces shipped.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कितने डिस्पैच और पीस ship हुए।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kitne dispatch aur piece ship hue.

title.en: Return a dispatch to the store

steps.en: Let's send pieces that are not going to Amazon back into the store. They are stock again straight away.
steps.hi: चलिए जो पीस Amazon नहीं जा रहे उन्हें स्टोर में वापस भेजते हैं। वे तुरंत फिर से स्टॉक बन जाते हैं।
steps.hg: Chaliye jo piece Amazon nahi ja rahe unhe store me wapas bhejte hain. Wo turant phir se stock ban jaate hain.

steps.en: Find the line — type the SKU.
steps.hi: लाइन ढूँढें — SKU लिखें।
steps.hg: Line dhoondhiye — SKU likhiye.

steps.en: Press Return on the line (or tick several and press Return ticked).
steps.hi: लाइन पर Return दबाएँ (या कई टिक करके Return ticked)।
steps.hg: Line par Return dabaiye (ya kai tick karke Return ticked).

steps.en: Pieces coming back is everything open — change it if fewer come back.
steps.hi: Pieces coming back में सारे खुले पीस हैं — कम आ रहे हों तो बदलें।
steps.hg: Pieces coming back me saare khule piece hain — kam aa rahe hon to badaliye.

steps.en: Say why they are not going.
steps.hi: लिखें वे क्यों नहीं जा रहे।
steps.hg: Likhiye wo kyun nahi ja rahe.

steps.en: Check it, then press Return to the store. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: सब चेक करें, फिर Return to the store दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Sab check kijiye, phir Return to the store dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says how many pieces are back in the store.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है कितने पीस स्टोर में वापस आए।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai kitne piece store me wapas aaye.

title.en: Undo an accept or a ship

steps.en: Undo takes one step back: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting. A return is undone by deleting it in Finished Goods.
steps.hi: Undo एक कदम पीछे ले जाता है: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting। Return को Finished Goods में डिलीट करके वापस करते हैं।
steps.hg: Undo ek kadam peeche le jata hai: shipped → accepted, accepted → waiting. Return ko Finished Goods me delete karke wapas karte hain.

steps.en: Choose Shipped or Accepted, not shipped.
steps.hi: Shipped या Accepted, not shipped चुनें।
steps.hg: Shipped ya Accepted, not shipped chuniye.

steps.en: Find the line — type the SKU or shipment id.
steps.hi: लाइन ढूँढें — SKU या shipment id लिखें।
steps.hg: Line dhoondhiye — SKU ya shipment id likhiye.

steps.en: Press Undo ship or Undo accept on the line. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: लाइन पर Undo ship या Undo accept दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Line par Undo ship ya Undo accept dabaiye. Ye asli me save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — this line says where the dispatch stands now.
steps.hi: हो गया — यह लाइन बताती है डिस्पैच अब किस हालत में है।
steps.hg: Ho gaya — ye line batati hai dispatch ab kis haalat me hai.
